narration.aldous_talk.bounty: "There's a raider in the gate yard. Bring him down and the bounty is yours."

narration.bess_talk.praise: Bess beams and smooths her apron.

narration.eat_stew_hearty: You eat your stew. It sits well.
narration.eat_stew_plain: You eat the stew. It warms you.
narration.fed.applied: The stew settles warm in you.
narration.fell: You slip on the drop and fall hard onto the stair below.

narration.hide.success: You settle behind the barrels where no eye falls.
narration.hungry.applied: The climb has given you an appetite.

narration.inspired.expired: The tune fades from your mind.

narration.lean_bess_failed: Bess has thrown out bigger than you.
narration.lean_warden_failed: The Warden laughs in your face.
narration.lever: The lever clanks down and springs back.
narration.lift_store_bar.success: You heave the bar out of its brackets and lean it against the logs.
narration.look_about_b: A seal watches you from the shallows, then is gone.
narration.look_about_c: Far out, a sail crosses the grey.
narration.lux: You speak lux and the ash flares.
narration.might.expired: The strength drains from your arms.
narration.might.tick: Your arms still burn with strength.
narration.nell_ash.press: Nell lowers her voice: Tam saw Wat at the toll gate, asking after his brother. Hal has sat in the toll cell since the fair on the Reeve's word, and the paper that would let him out never came down the fell.
narration.nell_rumour.press: Nell lowers her voice: Tam saw the mill loft burn, and the miller's lost son watching it.
narration.overheated.applied: The sun beats on your bare head.
narration.parched.applied: The dry wind sucks the water out of you.
narration.parched.tick: Your lips crack in the dry air.

narration.pick_hall_strongbox.success: The lock clicks open. Whatever the moot kept here is long gone.
narration.pick_strongbox.failure: The pick slips; you learn the lock a little better.
narration.play_song: You play a bright tune on the lute.
narration.poisoned.applied: A needle pricks you. Something sweet and cold spreads from the wound: you are poisoned, for two hours unless you find a cure.
narration.poisoned.expired: The poison fades from your blood.
narration.poisoned.tick: The poison burns in your veins.
narration.press_nell_ash_failed: Nell shakes her head. "Ask Tam, not me." Her voice wavers; ask again and she may give.
narration.press_nell_failed: Nell folds her arms. "I've said nothing." Her eyes flick to the door; she will not hold out forever.
narration.quench: You douse the flames. They hiss out.
narration.raise_timbered_hut.failure: The frame twists and falls; the timber is spoiled.
narration.raise_timbered_hut.success: You raise a timbered hut to the north.
narration.reeve_talk.accept: The Reeve jerks his chin at the letter. "To Wat, up the fell. Don't let it sit."
narration.reeve_talk.help: You sort a stack of his tallies. The Reeve grunts and pockets the count; there is always another stack.
narration.reeve_talk.wrong: You call the Reeve a cheat in front of the green. Heads turn at the well.
narration.saw.failure: The saw binds and the logs split.
narration.saw.success: You saw the logs into a timber.
narration.search_cellar: One flagstone at the foot of the stair sits proud. Another pressure plate.
narration.search_cleft: In the dark a cold draught breathes from the cleft: steps go up behind it.
narration.search_floor: One flagstone at the mouth of the passage sits proud. A pressure plate.
narration.search_pool_cleft: Behind the cleft you find the way the smugglers used: the stair from the sea cave.
narration.shove_drover.success: You shove the drover off his post.
narration.soaked.applied: Rain soaks you to the skin.
narration.stunned.applied: The wet stone carries the sparks: the golem locks up, stunned.
narration.think_hall_lectern.success: The miller's son came home the week of the fire, and nobody knew him: the heir to the mill is back, and someone wanted the ledger burned.
narration.think_lectern.success: The miller's son came home the week of the fire, and nobody knew him: the heir to the mill is back, and someone wanted the ledger burned.
narration.think_letter.success: The Reeve's thumbprint on that letter was Hal's way out of the cell before the moot. It is ash now, and the cell is still shut.
narration.thirsty.applied: Your mouth is dry from the climb.
narration.throw_bones.failure: The bones scatter through your fingers.
narration.throw_bones.success: Your hand is quicker than the bones: you catch all five.

narration.warden_talk.lean: The Warden steps back, lifts the bar and swings the gate open.

narration.warm.applied: The torch dries the golem's stone.

narration.wat_letter.deliver: Wat takes the letter and breaks the seal.
narration.wheel: The wheel clicks round one notch.
narration.wizard.leave: The hedge-wizard goes back to her hearth.
narration.wizard_lux.teach: "Lux," she says, and makes you say it twice.
narration.word_travels.applied: The broken lock hangs from the strongbox.
narration.word_travels.expired: The broken lock hangs from the strongbox.
narration.word_travels.tick: The broken lock hangs from the strongbox.
npc.aldous.description: A grey veteran with a soldier's patience.
npc.attic_golem.description: A practice golem of rough stone.
npc.attic_golem.room: A small [golem] stands in the corner.
npc.attic_wight.description: A wight the wizard keeps for practice.
npc.attic_wight.room: A bound [wight] sways in a chalk circle.
npc.bess.description: Bess keeps the moot hall's barrel and its gossip.
npc.bess.refuse: Bess turns to her barrel and does not look up.
npc.boar.description: A bristling boar with yellow tusks.
npc.carpenter.description: A carpenter with a pencil behind one ear and sawdust to the elbow.
npc.carpenter.room: The [carpenter] planes a board at the bench.
npc.chandler.description: A chandler whose prices rise as her shelf empties.
npc.chief.description: A scarred goblin with a bone crown. Nothing you shout will move it.
npc.clerk_a.description: A careful clerk with ink on one thumb.
npc.clerk_b.description: The counting house's second clerk, at a market table.
npc.cook.description: A thin man with flour to the elbow.
npc.drover.description: A big drover who does not like to be moved.
npc.farmer.description: A broad woman in a mud-brown smock.
npc.farmer.description_cold: A broad woman in a mud-brown smock. She will not look at you.
npc.farmer.description_warm: A broad woman in a mud-brown smock. She nods to you.
npc.fence.description: He buys what was lifted and nothing honest, and he never lets go of what he buys.
npc.fence.room: A thin [fence](fence) waits in the alley's mouth, one hand on his pack.
npc.gil.description: A gatekeeper leaning on his spear.
npc.gil.description_warned: Gil has his spear up; he heard you call.
npc.gil.room: [Gil] keeps the gate with a spear.
npc.goblin.description: A small, wiry goblin with a notched blade.
npc.goblin.room_afraid: A [goblin] cowers here, eyeing the way out.
npc.golem.description: Rough stone, cold to the touch. Water, sparks and fire all mark it.
npc.guard.arrest: The guard takes your arm: "Not in my market." He walks you to the cell behind the stalls.
npc.guard.description: A broad guard in a leather coat, patient as a post.
npc.guard.room: A [guard](guard) leans by the market door, watching the stalls.
npc.guard.room_wanted: The [guard](guard) stands square in the market door, his eyes on you.
npc.hedge_wizard.description: A small woman in a scorched apron, ash under her nails.
npc.hen.description: A brown hen with a bright eye.
npc.hob.description: Hob keeps the inn and minds his own business.
npc.idony.description: An old woman wrapped in a shawl, eyes on the sea.
npc.idony.description_winter: An old woman wrapped in two shawls against the winter, eyes on the grey sea.
npc.jailer.description: A tired jailer with a ledger and a ring of keys.
npc.jailer.room: The [jailer](jailer) sits by the door with a ledger.
npc.mark.description: He sleeps with his mouth open and his purse in plain sight.
npc.mark.room: A careless [man](mark) dozes against the yard wall, a purse at his belt.
npc.merchant.description: A well-fed merchant who watches his ledger and nothing else.
npc.merchant.room: A [merchant](merchant) counts on his fingers, his purse swinging loose at his belt.
npc.nell.description: Nell bakes for the whole village and remembers who paid.
npc.nell.refuse: Nell turns her back on you.
npc.orla.description: A brewer with steam in her hair.
npc.raider.description: A lean raider, watching the gate.
npc.reeve.description: The Reeve, chain of office over a patched coat, watches the road.
npc.reeve.description_cold: The Reeve does not look up.
npc.reeve.room: The [Reeve] stands by the moot stone.
npc.smith.description: A broad smith who takes your ore on trust.
npc.tam.description: Tam the carter, who sees everything on his rounds and tells all of it.
npc.tam.goal_church: Tam makes for the church porch out of the rain.
npc.tilt_boar.description: A second boar, kept for practice.
npc.tilt_boar.room: A [[tilt boar|boar]] snorts in the sand.
npc.vault.description: An iron vault, counted to the penny.
npc.warden.description: A heavy man with a cudgel and a long memory.
npc.warden.description_watchful: A heavy man with a cudgel. His eyes go to your hands and stay there.
npc.warden.engage: The Warden steps into your path and lifts his cudgel.
npc.warden.goal_green: The Warden shoulders his cudgel and walks west toward the green.
npc.warden.room: The [Warden] leans on the gate bar.
npc.warden.room_watchful: The [Warden] stands with his thumbs in his belt, watching your hands.
npc.wat.description: A broad shepherd with a weathered face.
npc.wat.description_ash: A broad shepherd with a weathered face. He turns his cap in his hands, round and round, and does not look at you.
npc.wat.description_chilled: Wat, blue-lipped and shivering, hugs himself against the cold.
npc.wat.goal_gate: Wat takes his crook and goes down the fell road.
npc.wat.room_ash: [Wat] turns his cap in his hands and does not look at you.
npc.wat.room_chilled: [Wat], blue-lipped and shivering, stamps his feet.
npc.watchman.description: An old watchman with sharp eyes and a slow step.
npc.watchman.engage: The watchman bars the stair: "You are wanted. Settle with the counting house first."
npc.watchman.room: A [watchman](watchman) walks the yard with a lantern.
npc.watchman.room_wanted: The [watchman](watchman) plants himself by the stair, lantern raised toward you.
npc.wight.description: A pale wight. Fire only half burns it.
npc.yard_chandler.description: She sells one candle at a time, on the hour.
quest.bounty.active: Bring down the raider in the gate yard.
quest.bounty.done: The raider is dead and Aldous's bounty is yours.
quest.bounty.title: The raider's bounty
quest.carry_letter.abandoned: You gave up on the letter.
quest.carry_letter.active: Take the Reeve's letter to Wat on the fell.
quest.carry_letter.burn: The Reeve's letter is ash in Wat's fire.
quest.carry_letter.deliver: Wat has the Reeve's letter, read and folded into his coat.
quest.carry_letter.hint_hut: Wat keeps the hut east of the fell top; he takes it from your hand.
quest.carry_letter.hint_road: The Fell Road runs north from the inn.
quest.carry_letter.hint_stone: The letter lies on the moot stone.
quest.carry_letter.late: Too late: the Reeve sent a rider instead, and he will remember it.
quest.carry_letter.objectives_met: You have the letter. Get it to Wat before time runs out.
quest.carry_letter.title: The Reeve's letter
quest.errand.abandoned: You gave up the hedge-wizard's errand.
quest.errand.active: Read the second word in the grimoire north of the loft.
quest.errand.done: You know flamma, and the hedge-wizard owes you the third word.
quest.errand.title: The hedge-wizard's errand
readable.grimoire: One word fills the page, written over and over: flamma. Spoken where the dead stand, it burns.
readable.mill_ledger: Flour sold, flour owed; then one line: "Fire in the loft, night of the fair. Stock lost." Someone has written beside it: "not lost".
readable.parish_roll: Old Miller Hale, buried; his son, it says, "gone to sea". A later hand adds: "returned, unknown, the week of the fire." Lower down, in fresh ink: "Hal, brother to Wat the shepherd, taken up at the toll gate at the fair."
readable.sign_body: The Fell Road. North of here the moor is open to the sky. Go up in frost, rain, gale or heat without the right garment from these pegs and your body pays by the hour, and a long enough bill is paid with your life; come back under this roof and it stops on its own. The climb makes you hungry and thirsty: Wat's hut, east on the top, has bread and a trough. Orla's still room, west, has a draught that makes you strong for an hour (try the quern), and a lute (try the knucklebones after a song). The fold, east of here, is the same sky with everything on one shelf.
readable.sign_combat: The Drill Yard. Aldous teaches the blade and lends the sword that goes with it; without a sword in hand your blows land nothing, here or anywhere. North, a boar is penned: you can hear it grunt from this yard. It gores: a wound that bleeds for a while and a scar that stays, even past your death. The poultice by the bench stops the bleeding; nothing takes the scar away. West, Gil keeps the gate with a raider in it; a shout of "ware" from this yard carries through the wall to him, and he fights beside you once you strike. Aldous pays a bounty on the raider, but only to one who takes it before the raider falls. South is a pit with two goblins who fight as a pack: in a pack you choose which one you hit. Every kill earns experience, each goblin of a pack too; thirty points make a level and a point to raise a stat, and raised strength bites harder. When you fall you wake at the inn with your level, your scar and your skill; what you carried waits on your corpse where you fell. The Warden in Low Wardle wears mail no blade gets through. The tilt yard, south of the gate, has a second boar, a goblin pack, a poultice and a draught. A stair goes down from this yard to the sappers' cellars.
readable.sign_homestead: The Holding. The carpenter west teaches the knife, the axe and the saw, and sells a plain hut if you would rather pay than learn; the stakes by this sign mark where a hut goes, and only one goes there. Carve sticks till your hand is steady and she will teach you carving; fell the oak in the glade twice and she will teach you the saw. Two timbers raise a hut, and a rug laid in it warms the boards. The farmer south likes an apple and not a dead rat, and trades a knife for two pelts without a penny passing. The pond east of her yard gives trout by day, eel at night and salmon in rain; the cook south of the yard turns two fish into a stew for a penny, or teaches you to do it at her hearth. Up the croft has hens, a pool that bites at any hour, and a plot where a seed from the yard sack can be sown too.
readable.sign_hub: Four roads, a ladder and a cellar stair leave this inn. North, the Fell Road: what weather, hunger and a strong drink do to a body. East, Tidewater Steps: tide, moon, night, a hidden stair and a cliff. South, Low Wardle: a village that remembers what you did and talks about it. West, the Drill Yard: a sword lesson, a boar that marks you, a pack that fights as one, and a fall you come back from with what you learned. Each road starts with a signpost like this one. Nothing here is a trap, except under the Drill Yard, where the sign says so first; when a door will not open, the words in the room say why. Through the Fell gate and west, the Holding: learn a trade, raise a hut with your own timber, furnish it, farm, fish, cook, and trade with a farmer who remembers a gift. Down the cellar steps, the Undercroft: a shelf whose price moves, a smith who takes your ore on trust, a bank with two counters, a strongroom you can buy, and a purse you can lift, seen or unseen. Up the ladder, the Loft: a hedge-wizard, three words that cost ash and breath, a dark crypt with something in it, and a golem that minds the weather.
readable.sign_law: The Undercroft. North, the market: the chandler's candles cost more as her shelf empties and she restocks on the hour; the merchant beside her carries a purse and does not watch it, but the guard watches him. Lift the purse in his sight and the guard will walk you to the cell east of the market the next time you come in, until you pay the jailer or the counting house its fine; hide behind the barrels in the alley first and nobody sees. The fence in the alley buys what was lifted and nothing honest, and keeps a hand on what he buys. The smith north of the market takes two ore and three pennies now and hands you the knife an hour later, or your ore back for a penny if you change your mind. The counting house east keeps savings you can draw at either counter for a penny each way, and sells the strongroom south of this sign: its key, its door and its chest open to the owner alone. The yard below has a purse, a watchman, barrels and a chest for trying it all again.
readable.sign_magic: The Loft. The hedge-wizard knows three words and will give you the first for nothing: "lux" lights the lantern on the sill, and costs two breaths of mana and a pinch of ash from the hearth here. The second word is in the book in the reading room north, where nothing may be spoken aloud for a while after you walk in. The third she gives for an errand, and it is no use to you until you have grown a level and some presence. East, a gate rusted shut: oil from the can on the winch and it swings; below it is dark, and what stands in the dark will not be seen, or struck, until you carry a light. Fire burns what is wooden down there; the bucket puts it out. West, a stone golem that does not mind rain, nor a spark, but minds both together; a torch dries it. The attic above has a wight of its own, with a bucket, a jar and a torch to try on it.
readable.sign_social: Low Wardle. Folk here have long memories and short tempers; mind how you go. The Reeve has work for a willing stranger. The Warden keeps the toll gate east. Tam the carter reaches the green at eleven with the news of the road. The church lectern is for quiet thought. The moot hall lies south.
readable.sign_traps: The Sappers' Stair. The flagstones here hide a plate that the passage north steps on: search this floor before you walk it, and disarm what you find; a clumsy hand sets it off, and it bites the same whether you find it or not. Its poison wears off in two hours, or at once with the bitters locked behind the dial east. The three levers in the hall east have an order, written on a note past the plate; the dial's numbers are on a slate behind the lever door. North of the plate a chief keeps two goblins. Shout "begone" and the goblins run; kill the chief and they run too. Down these stairs is a cellar with all of it, and the plate there is under your feet already.
readable.sign_world: Tidewater Steps. The cave east opens only at low tide; once open it stays open. The cliff path north climbs to a drop you can only take safely with the rope that lies at the top. Down there a stair leads back into the cave. The cave hides a shortcut up to that stair; you will only find it by searching after dark. The door on the cliff top opens under a full moon. Look about here more than once: the words change, and by your third visit the shore knows you. The pools south are all of this with every door open.
reason.ward: Needs a second level and more presence
room.boar_run.description: A muddy pen of split rails. The only way out is south, back to the yard.
room.boar_run.title: Boar Run
room.carpenter_shop.description: Shavings on the floor and tools on pegs. A [saw bench](saw_bench) takes up the middle. The lane is east.
room.carpenter_shop.title: The Carpenter's Shop
room.cell.description: A cold cell behind the stalls. A barred door leads west to the market; an iron [grate](grate_lock) in the floor covers a drain.
room.cell.title: The Market Cell
room.chief_den.description: A low den at the end of the passage, smoky and strewn with gnawed bones. The passage is south.
room.chief_den.title: Chief's Den
room.church.description: A low stone church smelling of candle smoke, a [lectern](lectern) before the altar. The green is east.
room.church.title: St Wenna's Church
room.cliff_path.description: A narrow path up the cliff face. The shore is south, the top north.
room.cliff_path.title: Cliff Path
room.cliff_top.dark_moon: A windy cliff top under a dark moon; the stone door east opens only under a full moon. The path runs south; a sheer drop falls away below.
room.cliff_top.description: A windy cliff top. The path runs south; a sheer drop falls away below; a stone door is set in the rock east.
room.cliff_top.full_moon: A windy cliff top under a full moon; the stone door east stands ready to open. The path runs south; a sheer drop falls away below.
room.cliff_top.title: Cliff Top
room.counting_house.description: A counter, a ledger and a barred hatch to the vault. The undercroft is west.
room.counting_house.title: The Counting House
room.crossroads_inn.description: A low inn where four roads meet. A [signpost](sign_hub) stands by the door. The fell road climbs north, the shore lies east, the village lane runs south and a gate in the west wall opens on the drill yard. A ladder climbs to the loft and cellar steps lead down.
room.crossroads_inn.title: Crossroads Inn
room.crypt.dark: It is pitch dark. Something breathes nearby. The stair is up.
room.crypt.description: A cold crypt, its walls lined with niches. A wooden bier stands in the middle. The stair is up.
room.crypt.title: The crypt
room.crypt_stair.description: Worn steps lead down to an iron gate. A rusted winch works its chain. The loft is west.
room.crypt_stair.title: The crypt stair
room.dial_vault.description: A small vault behind the dial door, its shelves bare.
room.dial_vault.title: Dial Vault
room.drain.description: A dripping brick drain under the market. The grate is overhead; the drain runs south and climbs to the counting house.
room.drain.title: The Drain
room.drill_yard.description: A beaten-earth yard ringed with straw targets. A [signpost](sign_combat) stands by the inn gate and a [bench](bench) runs along the wall. A pen lies north, a gate west and a pit south; the inn is east, and a stair goes down.
room.drill_yard.title: Drill Yard
room.farm_kitchen.description: A low kitchen smells of smoke and onions. A wide [hearth](hearth) fills one wall. The yard lies north.
room.farm_kitchen.title: The Farm Kitchen
room.farm_yard.description: A bare yard of packed earth. The lane is north, a glade opens west, a pond lies east and a kitchen south.
room.farm_yard.title: The Farm Yard
room.fell_gate.description: A stone shelter at the foot of the fell. Pegs line the wall. A weathered [signpost](sign_body) leans by the pegs. The moor opens north, the fold lies east, the Holding west and the inn south.
room.fell_gate.title: Fell Gate
room.fell_top.description: Open moor under a wide, quiet sky. A hut stands east, a brewhouse west; the shelter is south.
room.fell_top.drought: Open moor under the sky. The air is dry as dust and no garment helps; drink, and keep drinking. A hut stands east, a brewhouse west; the shelter is south.
room.fell_top.frost: Open moor under the sky. Frost whitens the heather and the cold bites; a wool cloak would keep it out. A hut stands east, a brewhouse west; the shelter is south.
room.fell_top.gale: Open moor under the sky. A gale tears at everything; wrap a scarf round your face. A hut stands east, a brewhouse west; the shelter is south.
room.fell_top.heat: Open moor under the sky. The sun beats down and nothing gives shade; a straw hat would help. A hut stands east, a brewhouse west; the shelter is south.
room.fell_top.rain: Open moor under the sky. Rain sheets across the heather; only an oilskin keeps it out. A hut stands east, a brewhouse west; the shelter is south.
room.fell_top.title: Fell Top
room.forge_back.description: A rack of finished work waiting for its owners.
room.forge_back.title: Behind the Forge
room.forge_stall.description: A smith's hearth cut into the rock, hot and loud. The market is south.
room.forge_stall.title: The Forge Stall
room.gate_yard.description: A walled yard before a timber gate. The drill yard is east; the tilt yard lies south.
room.gate_yard.title: Gate Yard
room.glade.description: A clearing round a great [oak](oak). The farm yard is east.
room.glade.title: The Glade
room.goblin_pit.description: A trampled hollow below the yard, ringed with stakes. The drill yard is north.
room.goblin_pit.title: Goblin Pit
room.golem_yard.description: A walled yard of wet flagstones. The loft door is east.
room.golem_yard.title: The golem yard
room.hall_closet.description: A cupboard deep enough to stand in, with one [shelf](closet_shelf). The hall is west.
room.hall_closet.title: The Cupboard
room.holding_croft.description: A croft on the slope above the lane, with a hen run, a [pool](croft_pool) and a cold [hearth](croft_hearth). The lane is down the slope.
room.holding_croft.title: The Croft
room.holding_lane.description: A cart lane between hedges. A [signpost](sign_homestead) stands by a row of [stakes](plot_stakes) that mark a plot north of the lane. The carpenter's shop is west, the farm yard south, the Fell Gate east and a croft up the slope.
room.holding_lane.title: The Holding Lane
room.larder.title: The Larder
room.lever_hall.description: A low hall cut from the rock. Three iron levers, [A](lever_a), [B](lever_b) and [C](lever_c), jut from the wall beside a heavy north door. By the east door sit three brass dial wheels: [first](wheel_1), [second](wheel_2), [third](wheel_3). The stair is west.
room.lever_hall.title: Lever Hall
room.lever_vault.description: A small vault behind the lever door, dry and cold. A [slate](vault_slate) is set into the wall.
room.lever_vault.title: Lever Vault
room.loft.description: A low loft under the inn's roof. A [slate](sign_magic) hangs by the ladder and a [hearth](hearth) smokes in the corner. A doorway opens north, a stair goes east, a yard door stands west and a ladder climbs to the attic.
room.loft.title: The Loft
room.loft_attic.description: A bare attic under the rafters, lit by a skylight, where the wizard tries things out. A small [hearth](attic_hearth) glows by the chimney. The ladder goes down.
room.loft_attic.title: The attic
room.market_row.description: A row of stalls under the arches. The forge glows north; the undercroft is south; a barred door east is the watch's cell.
room.market_row.title: Market Row
room.midden.description: A heap of shavings and scraps.
room.midden.title: The Midden
room.mill.description: The millhouse, scorched black along one wall; the [wheel](millwheel) still turns. The track runs down to the green; a wooden door south leads to the tollhouse, its latch on the far side.
room.mill.title: Wardle Mill
room.moot_hall.description: The village hall, where everything in Low Wardle can be tried at once: a strongbox with a small [lock](hall_strongbox_lock), a [lectern](hall_lectern) and a [cupboard](hall_cupboard). The green is north; an iron door to the tollhouse, west, is rusted shut, and a cupboard door is east.
room.moot_hall.title: The Moot Hall
room.pawn_alley.description: A narrow alley of shut doors, empty [barrels](barrels) stacked along one wall. The undercroft is east.
room.pawn_alley.title: Pawn Alley
room.plate_passage.description: A narrow passage, its walls shored with old timber. A [note](sapper_note) is pinned to the wall. The den lies north; the stair is south.
room.plate_passage.title: Plate Passage
room.pond.description: Reeds ring a brown pond. The yard lies west.
room.pond.title: The Pond
room.pond_deep.title: The Deep
room.reading_room.description: A hushed room of shelves and one lectern. The loft is south.
room.reading_room.title: The reading room
room.sapper_cellar.description: A damp cellar under the stair, paved with loose [flagstones](cellar_flags). The stair goes up.
room.sapper_cellar.title: Sappers' Cellar
room.sapper_stair.description: Rough steps come down from the Drill Yard into a cellar landing. A [signpost](sign_traps) leans by the bottom step, and worn [flagstones](flagstones) lead into a passage north. An archway opens east, and steps go down to a cellar.
room.sapper_stair.title: Sappers' Stair
room.sea_cave.description: A dripping cave. A [cleft](cleft) splits the back wall. The gate to the shore is west.
room.sea_cave.high_tide: A dripping cave. A [cleft](cleft) splits the back wall. The tide is in; the gate west will not open until it drops.
room.sea_cave.title: Sea Cave
room.shepherd_hut.description: A turf hut out of the wind, smelling of sheep. The moor is west.
room.shepherd_hut.title: Shepherd's Hut
room.shore_steps.autumn: A shingle shore below the cliff. Wrack piles up along the tideline. A [horizon](horizon) runs flat to the sky. A salt-white [signpost](sign_world) stands in the shingle. Steps climb north, a gate shuts the cave east, pools lie south and the inn west.
room.shore_steps.description: A shingle shore below the cliff. A [horizon](horizon) runs flat to the sky. A salt-white [signpost](sign_world) stands in the shingle. Steps climb north, a gate shuts the cave east, pools lie south and the inn west.
room.shore_steps.familiar: The shore you know by now: the [horizon](horizon), the [signpost](sign_world), the steps, the cave gate, the pools and the inn.
room.shore_steps.high_tide: The tide is in: water covers the cave mouth east and the gate will not open until the tide drops. A [horizon](horizon) runs flat to the sky. A salt-white [signpost](sign_world) stands in the shingle. Steps climb north, a gate shuts the cave east, pools lie south and the inn west.
room.shore_steps.rain: Rain hisses on the shingle. A [horizon](horizon) runs flat to the sky. A salt-white [signpost](sign_world) stands in the shingle. Steps climb north, a gate shuts the cave east, pools lie south and the inn west.
room.shore_steps.spring: A shingle shore below the cliff. Spring weed greens the rocks. A [horizon](horizon) runs flat to the sky. A salt-white [signpost](sign_world) stands in the shingle. Steps climb north, a gate shuts the cave east, pools lie south and the inn west.
room.shore_steps.summer: A shingle shore below the cliff. The shingle is warm underfoot. A [horizon](horizon) runs flat to the sky. A salt-white [signpost](sign_world) stands in the shingle. Steps climb north, a gate shuts the cave east, pools lie south and the inn west.
room.shore_steps.title: Tidewater Steps
room.shore_steps.winter: A shingle shore below the cliff. Ice rims the rock pools. A [horizon](horizon) runs flat to the sky. A salt-white [signpost](sign_world) stands in the shingle. Steps climb north, a gate shuts the cave east, pools lie south and the inn west.
room.smithy.description: A sooty smithy built of old timber. The [forge](forge) is cold. The fold is north; a barred wooden door leads south to the woodstore.
room.smithy.title: Smithy
room.smugglers_stair.description: A stair cut into the rock, slick with spray. It climbs up to the cliff and down to the cave.
room.smugglers_stair.title: Smugglers' Stair
room.stall.title: The Stall
room.still_room.description: Orla's brewhouse, warm and sour. A [hearth](hearth) glows; [knucklebones](knucklebones) lie on a stool. The moor is east.
room.still_room.title: Still Room
room.storeroom.description: A dark store of wax and wick.
room.storeroom.title: The Chandler's Storeroom
room.strongroom.description: A small stone room behind an iron door. The undercroft is north.
room.strongroom.title: The Strongroom
room.the_fold.description: A walled sheepfold open to the sky, with everything on one shelf. A [post](fold_post) stands in the middle, [knucklebones](fold_bones) lie on the wall and a fire pit, the [hearth](fold_hearth), smoulders. The shelter is west; a smithy lies south.
room.the_fold.title: The Fold
room.tide_pools.description: A shelf of rock pools, everything open. A [cleft](pool_cleft) in the rock, the [sky](pool_sky), the [water](pool_water) and the [shore](pool_shore) each tell you something. The steps are north, the cliff door west, the cave east.
room.tide_pools.title: Tide Pools
room.tilt_yard.description: A practice ground of churned sand. The gate yard is north.
room.tilt_yard.title: Tilt Yard
room.timber_yard.title: The Timber Yard
room.tollhouse.description: A cramped room of ledgers and tallies; a strongbox with a small [lock](strongbox_lock) sits under the desk. The gate is west; a [wooden door](tollhouse_door) leads north to the mill and an [iron door](iron_door), rusted shut, east.
room.tollhouse.title: The Tollhouse
room.undercroft.description: A vaulted cellar under the inn, lit by lamps on chains. A [signpost](sign_law) stands at the foot of the stair. The market lies north, the counting house east and an alley west; south, an iron-bound door; a second stair goes down to a yard.
room.undercroft.title: The Undercroft
room.vault_yard.description: A walled yard at the bottom of the second stair, for trying things again. Water [barrels](yard_barrels) line one wall. The undercroft is up.
room.vault_yard.title: The Vault Yard
room.village_green.description: A trodden green with a well, a [signpost](sign_social) and a flat [moot stone](moot_stone). The inn road runs north; the toll gate is east, the church west, the mill track climbs up and the moot hall south.
room.village_green.title: Low Wardle Green
room.warden_gate.description: The toll gate across the east road, with a hut for the Warden beside it. The green is west.
room.warden_gate.title: The Toll Gate
room.woodpile.description: Split logs stacked under a lean-to.
room.woodpile.title: The Woodpile
room.woodstore.description: Split [logs](logs) stacked to the rafters. The smithy is north, through a door with a [bar](store_bar) on this side.
room.woodstore.title: Woodstore
scene.letter_ash.1: The seal bubbles and the letter curls to ash.
scene.letter_ash.2: Wat looks at the ash, then at the door.
scene.letter_read.1: Wat reads the letter twice, lips moving.
scene.letter_read.2: "Tell the Reeve I'll come down for the moot." He folds it into his coat.
